description: WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND) of 9300-GETACCTDATA-BYACCT at :789-807 - the second of the three read sites and the one case in this folder whose subject is a preserved legacy defect rather than a branch. Path: EIBCALEN 172 with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT 1 and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM COCRDLIC, so :282-293 takes its ELSE and copies the inbound area; EIBAID DFHENTER is left alone by the PF-key gate at :306-314; the main EVALUATE TRUE at :323-383 reaches its third arm WHEN CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at :361, whose WHEN order - PFK03 at :324, ENTER at :353, REENTER at :361, OTHER at :375 - is preserved exactly (gate G30); 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT takes its ELSE, so INPUT-ERROR is false at :364 and :368-373 performs 9000-READ-ACCT, then 1000-SEND-MAP, then GO TO COMMON-RETURN, which bypasses the trailing IF INPUT-ERROR at :387-392. CURATION, stated plainly because it is the only way to reach this arm: measured over the whole fixtures, every XREF-ACCT-ID in cardxref.txt has a matching acctdata.txt row and every XREF-CUST-ID a matching custdata.txt row, so an account-master miss is impossible from the unmodified data. ACCTDAT is therefore seeded from an ordered list of literal rows rather than from the fixture: rows 0 to 48 of app/data/ASCII/acctdata.txt copied verbatim, 49 rows of exactly 300 bytes, with zero-based row 49 - account 00000000050, the account this case asks for - WITHHELD. Nothing else is altered: no surviving row's bytes are touched and no value is derived, which is what keeps this case distinct from case04, whose ACCTDAT row is a derivation. CCXREF and CUSTDAT are seeded from the complete unmodified fixtures, all 50 rows each, so the cross-reference alternate-key finder and the customer keyed read have to discriminate on their keys rather than return the only row present. 9200-GETCARDXREF-BYACCT SUCCEEDS on the '00' outcome (gate G47) and :739-740 moves XREF-CUST-ID 000000050 and XREF-CARD-NUM 0500024453765740 into the commarea; cardxref.txt is ordered by card number, not by account, so that row is zero-based row 0 and its XREF-ACCT-ID span sits at offset 25 for 11 bytes. CXACAIX is a PATH over the CCXREF base, reached through the one CardXrefRepository's alternate-key finder and never through a second repository or a second table (gate G45). The guard at :696-699 - whose original condition on :696 is itself commented out in favour of the flag test on :697 - does not fire. 9300 then reads DATASET(LIT-ACCTFILENAME), which is PIC X(8) VALUE 'ACCTDAT ' at :184-185 with its trailing space part of the value, RIDFLD(WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X) at 11 bytes per :79-80, KEYLENGTH 11, INTO(ACCOUNT-RECORD), LENGTH 300 - and misses. That is the '23' outcome of gate G47 on this call site, the second arm of the EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD at :786 whose order - NORMAL :787, NOTFND :789, OTHER :809 - is preserved (gate G30). The arm sets INPUT-ERROR at :790 and FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK at :791, then :793 finds WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF true because :278 set it and the 88 at :118 is VALUE SPACES, so :794-806 runs. The message is composed by STRING from seven operands, all DELIMITED BY SIZE so each contributes its full declared width including trailing spaces: 'Account:' (8, :797), WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X (11), ' not found in' (13, :799), ' Acct Master file.Resp:' (23, :800 - the period is followed immediately by 'Resp:', unlike 9200's ' Cross ref file.  Resp:' at :751 which carries two spaces), ERROR-RESP (10), ' Reas:' (6, :802) and ERROR-RESP2 (10). 8+11+13+23+10+6+10 is 81 characters into WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :117, so the receiver fills and the last six characters are lost - four of ERROR-RESP2's nine digits survive. The two response codes are not case data and cannot drift: a keyed miss reports no CICS RESP, so AccountViewController.cicsResp falls back to FileStatus.cicsRespOfBatchStatus('23'), which is DFHRESP(NOTFND) = 13, and RESP2 is CICS_RESP2_NOT_APPLICABLE = 0; both are compile-time constants (practice B7). MOVE WS-RESP-CD PIC S9(09) COMP TO ERROR-RESP PIC X(10) at :794-795 renders nine unsigned digits left justified with one pad space, giving '000000013 ' and '000000000 ', which is why two spaces separate the digits from ' Reas:'. :532 then moves the 75 characters into ERRMSGO PIC X(78), appending three. THE PRESERVED DEFECT, which is the point of this case: :792 reads '*           SET DID-NOT-FIND-ACCT-IN-ACCTDAT TO TRUE' - it is COMMENTED OUT. DID-NOT-FIND-ACCT-IN-ACCTDAT is an 88-level on WS-RETURN-MSG at :131-132 whose VALUE is 'Did not find this account in account master file', and the STRING above wrote a different text, so the condition is false and the guard at :704-706 that would have gone to 9000-READ-ACCT-EXIT NEVER FIRES. Execution therefore continues: :708 moves CDEMO-CUST-ID into WS-CARD-RID-CUST-ID and :710-711 PERFORMS 9400-GETCUSTDATA-BYCUST, which reads DATASET('CUSTDAT ') at :826 with a 9-byte RIDFLD and LENGTH 500, finds customer 000000050 and takes WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL) at :837-838, setting FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER. This is reproduced, not repaired (practice B5): a case that expected an early exit here would be asserting a program this repository does not contain. A second consequence follows from the same STRING: WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF is no longer true, so any later text guarded by IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF would be skipped. 9400 succeeds so nothing tries, but the single error line below is deliberate rather than incidental. 1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS then takes its ELSE at :464 with FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK false, so :468 echoes CC-ACCT-ID into ACCTSIDO. Its guard at :471-472 is FOUND-ACCT-IN-MASTER OR FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER - OR, not AND - and the customer flag is set, so the ten account moves at :473-490 DO run, over an ACCOUNT-RECORD that no read ever filled. COPY CVACT01Y at :244 is its own 01 group and is not among the three areas INITIALIZE names at :268-270, so it holds its allocated state, which FixedWidthRecord.forLayout builds with COBOL INITIALIZE category defaults: alphanumeric spans spaces, numeric spans zeros. ACSTTUSO is therefore one space, ADTOPENO, AEXPDTO - :488 moves ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE, and the copybook's misspelling is preserved verbatim - AREISDTO and AADDGRPO are ten spaces each, and the five PIC +ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.99 receivers at :475-485 render '+           .00': the sign is forced, all nine Z positions are suppressed because the integer part is zero and both commas are blanked with them, and the two decimals are still present because the mask ends .99 and not .ZZ - 15 characters, the LENGTH the mapset declares. :493-523 then populates all eighteen customer fields from the real row, with the width-driven truncations the fixtures force: ACSZIPCO PIC X(5) keeps '04257' of CUST-ADDR-ZIP PIC X(10), ACSPHN1O and ACSPHN2O PIC X(13) each drop two characters of a PIC X(15) source, ACSTSSNO is the :496-504 STRING '931-24-8469' laid into a PIC X(12) item whose twelfth byte STRING leaves as the LOW-VALUES :432 put there, and the field the screen labels City is fed from CUST-ADDR-LINE-3 at :513. :528-530 flips WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE - set at :689 - to WS-PROMPT-FOR-INPUT, whose 88 literal at :113-114 is exactly 40 characters and therefore fills PIC X(40) with no pad before :534 moves it into INFOMSGO PIC X(45), appending five. 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS moves DFHBMFSE into ACCTSIDA at :543, takes the identically-bodied EVALUATE at :546-552 - both arms and WHEN OTHER move -1 into ACCTSIDL, and the redundancy is left exactly as written (practice B5) - and colours the field DFHDFCOL at :555 and then DFHRED at :557-559 because FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is set. The asterisk at :561-565 stays away because it needs FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK: red WITHOUT the marker, which is FieldAttributeSetter's rule, implemented inline here because COACTVWC does not copy CSSETATY (gate G38). INFOMSGC is DFHNEUTR at :570 rather than DFHBMDAR because :529 already flipped the flag :567 tests, and every xxxH item stays DFHDFHI because the program writes no extended highlight. 1400-SEND-SCREEN names mapset COACTVW and map CACTVWA at :579-580 and sets CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at :581, so the response context is 1 and CDEMO-CUST-ID and CDEMO-CARD-NUM are populated from the successful 9200; COMMON-RETURN at :394-407 is an EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CAVW') carrying the whole area, and no state is held server side (gate G37, rule R6). The program writes nothing - its only file verbs are the three EXEC CICS READs at :727, :776 and :826 - so expectedWrites is empty as a positive assertion, the return code is 0, and all 149 seeded rows are pinned unchanged on the final-state channel: 50 cross-reference rows at the 50 bytes CVACT03Y declares, normalised from the fixture's 36 by CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 with the trailing FILLER X(14) as 14 spaces (gate G16, risk R-F), 49 account rows at 300 and 50 customer rows at 500 with their FILLER X(168) space filled (gates G19 and G21). The two composed texts are carried in ERRMSGO and INFOMSGO rather than in expectedMessages, because the message channel of this harness records only SEND-PLAIN-TEXT at :877-887, which a path that paints a map never reaches; an entry there would assert an emission this path does not make. Every value above is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of the COBOL - 9300 at :776-820, the commented-out SET at :792, the consequently dead guard at :704-706, 9400 at :826-870 and 1200's OR at :471-472 - cross-checked against the copybook offsets in app/cpy, the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COACTVW.CPY, the PICOUT masks of app/bms/COACTVW.bms and the real app/data/ASCII fixtures. None of it was captured from a live COBOL execution, which this environment cannot run (risk R-A). The clock is pinned at 2022-07-19T23:15:58, the instant the CardDemo version footer carries, so CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are fixed rather than sampled (practice B7).
